# varnish Provider

Manage Varnish resources via the Varnish REST API. Currently Varnish CDN (varnish_cdn_*) plus the org-level resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    varnish = {
      source = "varnish/varnish"
    }
  }
}

# Endpoint and token may also be supplied via the VARNISH_ENDPOINT and
# VARNISH_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variables.
provider "varnish" {
  # endpoint   = "https://api.varnish-cdn.com" # the default; override for other stacks
  access_token = var.varnish_access_token
  # insecure   = true  # only for local/test stacks with self-signed certs
}

variable "varnish_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Long-lived API access token. May be set via VARNISH_ACCESS_TOKEN.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the API gateway. Defaults to https://api.varnish-cdn.com; may be overridden here or via VARNISH_ENDPOINT.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification, and allow a plain http endpoint (test stacks only). May be set via VARNISH_INSECURE.
